architecture: One fixed five-seed decoder-generated PMG1 anchor span, fitted jointly per matrix and scored on frozen disjoint auxiliary coordinates.
research_question: Can these five predeclared procedural anchors jointly remove at least the metadata-adjusted 19.10966610577134 percent of Qwen Up/Down source energy on untouched coordinates, after decoded-FP16 fitting, without paying dense-anchor read bandwidth?

fixed_hypothesis.interpretation: The five integers are public constants of one fixed hypothesis. They are not represented as authenticated winners of a complete u32 search.

frozen_coordinate_plan.construction: Exact source-only reconstruction of historical FUSEED-U32-v1 stage 0 followed by the frozen stage1 fill.

generator_and_fit.generator: Exact CURRENT_PMG_GATE_UP_DIRECT_BF16 Philox/cuRAND Box-Muller ABI with role-specific scale words, counter mapping, BF16 round/decode, and Down transpose.
generator_and_fit.anchor_storage: No dense anchor tensor is serialized or read by the prospective decoder.
generator_and_fit.fit_per_identity: Center five anchor columns and target on only that identity's frozen fit keys; accumulate the 5x5 Gram and five RHS values by explicit canonical-order binary64 operations.
generator_and_fit.solve: Fixed ordinal-order binary64 Cholesky, forward substitution, reverse-ordinal back substitution; no contracted multiply-add is specified.
generator_and_fit.condition: Fixed-order deterministic Jacobi replay; reject nonpositive numerical rank or condition number above 2^20.
generator_and_fit.serialization: Round beta_0..beta_4 and intercept independently to IEEE binary16 RNE, reject negative zero/nonfinite, decode the literal words, and score only that decoded reconstruction.
generator_and_fit.metric: c_joint = 1 - sum((W_score - decoded_joint_prediction)^2) / sum(W_score^2), pooled by literal SSE and source energy.
generator_and_fit.nonadditivity: Exactly one five-anchor reconstruction and one residual are scored. The five historical marginal captures are never added, multiplied, or transferred.

controls_and_uncertainty.control_action: Independently permute anchor rows within each expert-role identity and split; source values and coordinate counts remain fixed; refit and rescore the complete pentad.
controls_and_uncertainty.source_control_order: A survivor must exceed every frozen scramble-control aggregate capture.
controls_and_uncertainty.jackknife: Delete one whole expert at a time, omitting both Up and Down when present; 12 clusters, never 23 matrix pseudo-replicates.
controls_and_uncertainty.uncertainty_gate: raw pooled source capture minus three delete-expert standard errors

survivor_requirements: every one of 23 held-out identity captures is strictly positive
pooled Up capture and pooled Down capture are each strictly positive
primary aggregate capture exceeds all 16 frozen scramble controls
all coefficients, Gram eigenvalues, SSEs, energies, captures, controls, and decision distances are finite
decision.survivor_consequence: May request a separately audited and separately authorized stage-2 review only; supplies no Gate, validation, codec, or target evidence.
decision.failure_consequence: Kills only this exact fixed pentad at this auxiliary gate; does not establish a PMG-family or universal procedural-anchor negative.

physical_planning_ledger.rate_rule: Debit every side bit from the residual payload so the prospective literal total remains 2.5 bpw.

historical_context.warning: The adverse tetrad is strong prioritization evidence against the fixed pentad, but it neither measures the fifth seed jointly nor used the required delete-one-expert clusters. The pentad gate is retained only because it is cheap and source-closed.

A separate human/root authorization must explicitly permit only the 23-file auxiliary Up/Down payload scope; this package cannot authorize itself.
An independently owned dispatcher must bind the exact source manifest, source roots, CUDA device, Python/NumPy/CuPy/CUDA versions, and an absent fail-closed output namespace.
The dispatcher must independently rederive all 4096 coordinate keys and audit the CuPy kernel against the frozen PMG ABI before source access.
The dispatcher must bind this package manifest hash and refuse dirty, extra, missing, symlinked, or hash-mismatched members.
No Gate, stage 2, validation, pinned panel, residual codec, or model-family payload may be opened under auxiliary stage-1 authority.
